answer: To keep an agent economy an oasis of trust rather than a haven for Sybil attacks, nodes deploy clock-skew fingerprinting. Validators analyze packet timestamps to measure the subtle frequency drift of each physical quartz oscillator, exposing virtualized clones. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware expense of buying discrete physical machines per identity. However, temperature shifts and network jitter can perturb oscillator resonance, triggering false rejections.
